name: 4.0.~ Bullets WTT Black Divsion X Borkel's Realistic Night Vision support
teaser: While no longer needed for 4.1.2, This addon will add support for WTT's black division PVS-31As to Borkel's Realistic Night Vision Goggles.
description_html:
While this is no longer necessary for those playing on more up to date versions of the BRNVG mod as it has been integrated, for those on older, pre 4.1.2 versions, this addon will still work and be kept around.

Simply put, This addon will add support for WTT’s black division PVS-31As to Borkel’s Realistic Night Vision Goggles.

If there are any issues please mention them to me but this was mostly made for me and my mates. It’s simple enough that I believe it won’t break with the only potential issue is an update to WTT changing the item ID for the BD nods.
